 Phil Wickham set to release new Christmas album
 Faith Adeyemi, 
 CHVNRadio.com | 
 Wednesday, Nov 18 2026, 3:39 PM 
 Share: 
 Copied! 
 Phil Wickham is celebrating the upcoming release of his Christmas album on Friday (Phil Wickham/Instagram). 
 Article continues below advertisement ↴ 
 Phil Wickham is celebrating the upcoming release of his Christmas album on Friday.
 "My album 'Hallelujah! It’s Christmas AGAIN!' is coming November 20th," said Wickham in a statement  online .
 He says the album will feature new renditions of prior work and showcase new work. "This expanded version of my previous Christmas album has 4 new studio songs and 3 live Christmas moments."
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by Phil Wickham (@philwickham)

 Wickham's hope is to bring people closer to Jesus through his songs. 
 "Praying these songs bring you closer to Jesus and remind you of the joy we have in Him this Christmas season."
